notes.title: Get Ready – Playtest Coming Soon!
notes.content:
⚡We've been working hard behind the scenes, and now we’re excited to invite you to an [b]upcoming playtest[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44256748/889f5c3f32597b106b4f9ecb387eb10d953a4b29.jpg[/img]

🕹️ What to Expect?
[list]
[*] Early hands-on experience with the game
[*] A chance to provide feedback and shape development
[*] Exclusive access before the official release
[/list]

📅 When?
Details coming very soon - make sure to follow and wishlist the game so you don’t miss out!

🔔 How to Join?
Stay tuned! We’ll be sharing all the details shortly.

Be ready - this is your moment to play before anyone else! 🚀

Join our Discord server to stay updated and be the first to enter the playtest: https://discord.gg/K9kWG8r86S
